FULL TEXT:
HARCOURT BUTLER TECHNICAL UNIVESRITY, KANPUR
Tentative Dates for Direct Recruitment to various Teaching and Medical
officer Post in the University
(Advertisement No.: HBTU/ESTT/ 02/2024, December 7th 2024)
S.
No.
Particulars (as applicable for different faculty/Medical
officer posts) Dates
1 Date of the Advertisement December 7th 2024
2 Last date of receipt of online applications January 21st 2025, 05.30 PM
3 Display of Academic Score/API (to invite objections, if any
by the candidates) (For all advertised post) (7 days-time given
to candidates for inviting objections)*
March 3rd 2025, 07.00 PM
4 Last date of inviting objections on the API score** for all
advertised post
March 10th 2025, 7.00 PM
5 Display of Revised/Final Academic Score/API of candidates
after redressal of objections, if any for all advertised post
March 17th 2025, 5.00 PM
6 Issue of Online Admit Cards (only for the eligible candidates
to the post of Assistant Professor and Medical officer)*
March 24th 2025, 2.00 PM
7 Date of Written Test* (Objective type) (Only for the post of
Assistant Professor and Medical Officer)
March 30th 2025, Sunday
(12.00-2.00 PM)
Venue: Main Building HBTU
Nawabganj, Kanpur-2080002
8 Display of result of the written test (to invite objections, if any
by the candidates) (3-days-time given to candidates) (For the
post of Assistant Professor and Medical Officer)
March 31st 2025, 5.00 PM
9 Last date for invitation of objections on the score of written
test, if any (For the post of Assistant Professor and Medical
Officer)
April 3rd 2025, 5.00 PM
10 Display of revised score of written test (after redressal of
objections on test score)
April 7th 2025, 5.00 PM
11 Display of candidates short-listed for Teaching skills and
Interviews (as applicable for various posts)
April 8th 2025, 5.00 PM
12 Interview schedule (tentative) 19th -25th April, 2025
*All the above information would be displayed on the university website www.hbtu.ac.in
under the “Recruitment Link”
**- Any correspondence in regard of this recruitment should be made on the email only
(recruitment2024@hbtu.ac.in)
